BREAKING: US data center construction spending jumped +46% YoY in June, to a record annualized rate of $68 billion.

This marks the largest YoY increase in 12 months.

Since January 2024, US data center construction spending has surged +158% and has more than tripled since 2022.

EY: FED LIKELY TO STAY ON HOLD THROUGH YEAR-END

Wall Street expects July payrolls to rise 83K, but EY says the labor market remains stable and is unlikely to shift
